findings.title: Incomplete reporter output lacks fail-closed handling
findings.description:
D10 handles timeouts and missing or malformed JSONL with a nonzero pytest exit, but not missing output after exit zero or valid, incomplete output after an abrupt process exit. Consumers cannot reliably distinguish a completed suite from partial observations. This leaves the architecture’s “absent is not zero” requirement unmet.

Define report completion validation, reconcile it with pytest’s exit status, and return an explicit harness error for incomplete reporting. Test abrupt termination mid-report and missing output after exit zero.

findings.title: Per-phase reports lack a per-node reduction contract
findings.description:
The plugin emits one result per test phase, but the slice promises per-node outcomes to qualification (422) and grading (425). It never defines how setup, call and teardown results combine. A passing call followed by a teardown failure could therefore be interpreted differently by consumers.

Specify one authoritative outcome per node, including failure precedence, fixture errors, skips, expected failures and interrupted phases. Preserve phase details separately and test multi-phase combinations.
